entries.0a4e3ce3bdf6c189: The company states that it will pursue new market development in domestic and overseas markets in the fields of EVs, information and communications, industrial equipment, medical equipment, and energy conservation and environment; aim to expand sales through sales efforts in China, Hong Kong and Europe; work on continuous quality improvement and cost reduction at its overseas production plants; and strengthen a profit-oriented structure. Its priority issues are the following 3 points: winning new orders for items such as battery management systems for EVs; quality improvement aimed at cost reduction, together with renewal of manufacturing equipment and promotion of labor saving, automation and DX; and promotion of material development aimed at high reliability, higher efficiency and smaller, higher-frequency products.
